title: Execute the remote-sealed single-attempt B25 candidate interaction and golden restoration

authorization.user_statement: 许可使用Quartus和JTAG来烧写和测试设备；直接使用给定nios2-terminal命令读取和交互。
authorization.scope: One volatile candidate configuration, one direct terminal session and one volatile golden restoration using the exact sealed runner.

writes: build/agents/T-20260920-037/** ignored sealed copy and board evidence

runner_contract.immutability: Copy these nine files byte-for-byte into T-037. No apply_patch or other edit to tools is permitted. Generate only a new task-id-specific script-manifest.json.

scope: Copy and verify the exact T-036 bundle, generate a T-037 manifest, and invoke the sealed run_board_once.sh exactly once in one gamepc lock window. The runner itself performs fresh root/bootstrap, remote AST/seal, golden preflight, one candidate program, one live terminal interaction, one golden restore and postflight.

acceptance.local_seal: All nine tool hashes equal T-036 before execution; no tool diff. New manifest differs only by task_id and remains internally consistent.
acceptance.transport: Fresh T-037 root/bootstrap, one upload, remote AST 6/6 and seal 9/9 PASS before preflight.
acceptance.preflight: Exact initial golden identity, no conflicts/port owner, preserved standard jtagserver and expected cable/JTAG nodes.
acceptance.single_use: Durable markers and logs prove candidate quartus_pgm invocation count=1, terminal session count=1 and golden quartus_pgm invocation count=1. No reconnect, script replacement or retry.
acceptance.candidate_program: Exact candidate path/hash/checksum/JTAG-ID, programmer exit0, configuration/operation success, 0 errors/warnings. Cached standard design hash is diagnostic only.
acceptance.live_identity: Before any byte, one terminal session shows LCVEX25 BOOT, CAL state, DDR state, READY, zero RXDBG and later nonzero-read/zero-event TX-drain RXDBG in order.
acceptance.commands: Same session paced ? -> CLOCK25, p -> PONG, d -> manual RXDBG event=3/byte=0x64, Z -> post-offset echo; stop at first missing response.
acceptance.observability: Final RXDBG event=4/byte=0x5A; RXPATH bridge=PoC=dmem low16 A45A counts 4/4/4 fault 0; RXCPU getc/dispatch=4, A45A, class5/Z and positive putc/TX.
acceptance.golden: Exactly one golden restore succeeds and final postflight proves exact golden hash/design, UART/PHY, standard server preserved, no busy task processes and port1310 free. Final board state golden.
acceptance.overall: Only every above predicate yields PASS; programmer/startup/partial command evidence is insufficient.

failure_policy: No internal retry under any failure, including setup/AST/preflight/programmer/terminal/parser/golden. Preserve evidence and stop after the single runner invocation; do not edit tools, recreate root, reprogram, reconnect, reset, power-cycle or use Flash.
resource: One uninterrupted resource-lock gamepc window for the single sealed runner invocation. Event-driven waits up to one hour; no other GamePC task.
forbidden_regions: any modification to sealed tool files
more than one runner/candidate/golden/terminal invocation or any retry
JIC/EPCQ/Flash, reset, power cycle, standard/unknown process stop
using cached candidate design hash as gate or treating programmer success alone as functional pass

dispatch.monitoring: event-driven; one-hour maximum wait; no frequent polling
